task_contract.name: permuted_keyed_memory
task_contract.slot_permutation: Each example independently places valid stable identities in random slots among padded positions; the readout slot also varies.
task_contract.initial_topology: Two persistent edges per sample: one query edge with a randomized relation type and strength, plus one distractor edge. No edge/action labels are supplied to the task optimizer.
task_contract.targets: Single-link task routes 0.60 times the queried value. Two-link task routes 0.60 times the queried value plus 0.35 times its cyclic successor. Correct topology requires add, remove, retype, and strength update actions across examples.

decision_rules.quality_ci: Paired per-seed relative MSE delta; 95% two-sided t interval upper bound must be below zero.
decision_rules.interpretation: Thresholds are fixed before the run; unmet results stay unmet and are not tuned after observing test data.

cost_alignment.linear_mac_proxy_contract: Counts Linear output elements times input width for batch size one; scatter, reductions, pointwise ops, optimizer and memory traffic are excluded. Wall time is separately measured.

limitations: Synthetic retrieval/composition tasks do not establish natural-language or broad capability claims.
The stable identity registry is caller-owned; this experiment varies node slots and uses remap_node_ids tests, but does not serialize registries across process restarts.
Linear MAC is a transparent proxy rather than total FLOPs; empirical MPS step time is the end-to-end cost measure.
MPS and host memory use 2 ms sampling and can miss shorter peaks.
Pool-size generalization is tested only over 4 to 16 memory neurons in this run.
validity: EXCLUDED: controls consumed randomized raw slots while the graph model used stable node identities; retain as diagnostic output only.
